acceptance: Every failure from a release_line_create.py-built overlay of the newest tag is classified (overlay artefact, test-order interference, real carry gap) with evidence.
Real carry gaps are fixed in the carry lists or tests, and the overlay run passes, or the remaining failures have an owner decision recorded.
description:
Running the tests carried by #4402 on a v0.5.1 tree with the carried files applied gave 1363 passed and 43 failed. The author saw two groups: review-workflow tests failing because the overlay lacked the reviewer workflows (which a real line gets from release_line_create.py), and 13 test_pr_landing batch tests that pass when run alone (cross-test interference in the overlay). The rest were not classified. A real line created by release_line_create.py may or may not show the same failures; the line's first PR would then fail CI.

Guardrails: build the overlay with release_line_create.py's own carry logic (not a hand copy); do not move tests into NOT_CARRIED just to make the run green without a stated reason.
